## Welcome to the Most Natural Destination

Artipelag is an international destination for art, design, food, and events—beautifully situated on Värmdö in the Stockholm archipelago—just 30 minutes from downtown Stockholm.

[Learn more about Artipelag](https://artipelag.se/om-artipelag/)

Membership at Artipelag

## Discover more with Artipelag’s Art.Pass

Installation view INNER CHILD: Playing with Design. Works from left: Humberto da Mata, ORGUS, 2024; Jonathan Bocca, Giraffa Alta, 2023, Giraffa Lamp, 2023, Zampa Chair, 2022; Elsa Dray-Farges, Fox, Rabbit & Pig, 2026. Photographer Jean-Baptiste Béranger.

Art.Pass is Artipelag’s discounted membership card that provides one year of unlimited admission to art exhibitions, discounted prices on concerts, activities, and art experiences, as well as great deals at the Design Shop and restaurants. 

- Free admission to all art exhibitions and open house events for 12 months (from the date of purchase).
- Discounted prices on most shows, concerts, and art experiences\*.
- Selected offers at the Design Store, Bådan Café & Konditori, and Artipelag Restaurant.

[Learn more about Art.Pass](https://artipelag.se/konsthallen/art-pass/)

\*Art.Pass does not include free admission to concerts and events at Artboxen. However, Art.Pass members receive discounted prices for these events.

Artipelag Restaurant & Café

## Eat and drink in a uniquely natural setting

Experience the best of Stockholm’s cuisine and archipelago from an unbeatable location overlooking the sparkling waters of Baggensfjärden. Our menu is inspired by the surrounding nature, with an emphasis on seasonal and locally sourced ingredients.

- [Go to the restaurant](https://artipelag.se/mat-dryck/artipelag-restaurang/)
- [Go to Bådan Café & Pastry Shop](https://artipelag.se/mat-dryck/badan/)

Artipelag Design Store

## Discover Beautiful, Sustainable, and Innovative Design

Our design store, with its elegant boat-shaped architecture, is part of the Artipelag experience. Here you’ll find a selection of unique products in the spirit of Artipelag, featuring beautiful, sustainable, and innovative designs.

- [Shop in our online store](https://butik.artipelag.se/)
- [Read about the design store](https://artipelag.se/designbutiken/)

## Discover more

[**Direct Bus to Artipelag**\\ \\ Take the direct bus to Artipelag—a convenient, direct trip that takes just 30 minutes. Direct buses run on weekends—in both directions between downtown Stockholm and Artipelag.](https://artipelag.se/en/plan-your-visit/direct-shuttle/) [**Take a boat to Artipelag**\\ \\ From May through September, you can take a boat to Artipelag on Strömma Kanalbolaget’s turn-of-the-century vessel, the “M/S Gustafsberg VII.” The boat departs from Strandvägen to and from Artipelag, and the trip takes about 1.5 hours. Do you have your own boat? You’re welcome to dock at our guest harbor.](https://artipelag.se/en/plan-your-visit/)

We share the latest happenings at Artipelag – from new exhibitions to unique experiences and offers.

# A unique tour through the baroque heart of Salzburg’s historic centre. One ticket, one experience!

The unique tour through the baroque heart of Salzburg 
For the first time in 200 years, the Residence and Cathedral area – including the Benedictine monastery of St Peter – can once again be experienced in a coherent tour. With the opening of the DomQuartier in 2014, an internationally unique museum has been created.

The entire tour of the DomQuartier leads through

[the state-rooms of the Residenz](https://www.domquartier.at/en/state-rooms/)

[the Residenzgalerie (currently closed)](https://www.domquartier.at/en/residenzgalerie/)

[the Cathedral Museum](https://www.domquartier.at/en/cathedral-museum/)

[the Museum of St Peter](https://www.domquartier.at/en/dauerausstellung/1300-years-of-monastic-history-museum-of-st-peters-abbey/)

**Further highlights in the DomQuartier** 
Enjoy the breathtaking and unique views and vistas in the DomQuartier. Highlights include

- the cathedral arch terrace with a view of Salzburg’s old town and
- the organ gallery with a view of Salzburg Cathedral

The countless windows in the rooms and corridors of the DomQuartier offer exciting views of Salzburg’s old town. They are located above the most interesting squares in Salzburg’s Old Town: Residenzplatz with the Residenzbrunnen fountain, Domplatz with St Mary’s Column and Alter Markt.

[To the tour](https://www.domquartier.at/en/tour/)

The heart of the UNESCO World Heritage City of Salzburg beats in the DomQuartier Salzburg! Are you looking for a special experience in Salzburg? Find out more about the current exhibitions, events and concerts at the DomQuartier and be mesmerised by 1,300 years of Salzburg’s imperial history, art, music and architecture.

[Useful information for your visit to the DomQuartier](https://www.domquartier.at/en/events/the-domquartier-tour/)

## Visit us

Hallands Konstmuseum (Halland Art Museum) is beautifully situated beside the River Nissan and Norre Katts Park in central Halmstad. Several exhibitions are always on display simultaneously, often drawing on our extensive collection of Halland art. Guided tours are offered every weekend and are included in the admission fee. On the ground floor, there is a museum shop and a restaurant with panoramic windows and a lovely outdoor terrace, where the water flows just below.

[Visit us](https://hallandskonstmuseum.se/en/visit-us/)

## Discover art together with your family!

Explore art as a family! At Hallands Konstmuseum (Halland Art Museum), there are exciting activities for all ages. Listen to our family stories, solve tricky art riddles, or get creative in the studio. There’s always something to discover – no matter your age!

## Our Collections

Hallands Konstmuseum (Halland Art Museum) has an extensive and continually growing collection of Halland art, including works by the Halmstadgruppen (Halmstad Group), Thea Ekström, Olle Bærtling and Lotta Antonsson. Our approach to art is broad and inclusive. In addition to traditional forms such as painting, sculpture and printmaking, the collection also includes photography, craft and architecture. The museum also houses an older cultural-historical collection, a large number of books and an extensive archive. A rich selection from the collection is always on display in the exhibitions.

## Museums The Royal Museums of Fine Arts of Belgium, a prestigious collection of 20,000 works of art

The Museums’ collections trace the history of the visual arts – painting, sculpture and drawing – from the 15th to the 21st centuries. They preserve the works of the Flemish Primitives, of Pieter Bruegel, Peter Paul Rubens, Jacques Jordaens, Jacques Louis David, Auguste Rodin, James Ensor, Paul Gauguin, Fernand Khnopff, Henry Moore, Paul Delvaux, René Magritte, Marcel Broodthaers and many others.

The Royal Museums of Fine Arts of Belgium include 4 museums :

### [musée magritte museum – From the quotidian to the extraordinary.](https://www.musee-magritte-museum.be/en)

Discover this essential cultural centre in the heart of Brussels. The Magritte Museum presents an outstanding collection of works by Belgian Surrealist artist René Magritte (1898-1967), one of the world's most famous  artists.  The collection of over 200 works is the largest in the world. This museum, with its 2500 m2 of contemporary museography, is the international reference centre for the work of this multidisciplinary artist.

[Read more…](https://www.musee-magritte-museum.be/en)

### [musée oldmasters museum – A stroke of genius.](https://fine-arts-museum.be/en/museums/musee-oldmasters-museum)

The remarkable collection of Old Masters, a testament to a rich past, spans from the 15th to the 18th century. Here you'll discover Memling, Bosch, Bruegel, Rubens, Van Dyck, Jordaens… Since 2025, the museum has enhanced its visitor experience by gradually introducing new display sections showcasing collections up to the 21st century.

[Read more…](https://fine-arts-museum.be/en/museums/musee-oldmasters-museum)

### [musée wiertz museum – Exhilaration and glorification](https://fine-arts-museum.be/en/museums/musee-wiertz-museum)

**The Musée Wiertz will be temporarily closed for works from 11/10 -** The work will involve renovating the museum entrance (outside and inside) and the caretaker's lodge. The Wiertz Museum will be closed to the public for the duration of the works. It is scheduled to reopen in 2026. A more specific date will be announced as soon as possible.

[Read more…](https://fine-arts-museum.be/en/museums/musee-wiertz-museum)

### [musée meunier museum – The art of labour & the labour of art.](https://fine-arts-museum.be/en/museums/musee-meunier-museum)

Unfairly overlooked by the general public, the home and studio of painter and sculptor Constantin Meunier (1831-1905) in Ixelles presents a hundred and fifty at times monumental works, and bronzes of all sizes. The creations of this artist inspired by the industrial, political and social developments of late 19th century Belgium provide a realistic view of the world of work and industry of his day.

[Read more…](https://fine-arts-museum.be/en/museums/musee-meunier-museum)
